## AKCA v0.2.3

This release focuses on report clarity, terminal presentation, and transparent scan behavior.

### Highlights

- Redesigned the HTML security report around an executive risk overview, severity distribution, vulnerability statistics, and detailed scan metadata.
- Reorganized each finding into affected endpoint, description, impact, classification, recommendation, and evidence sections.
- Added tabbed HTTP request and response evidence with proof highlighting, cURL reproduction, and clipboard controls.
- Added a prominent partial-coverage warning so incomplete scans cannot be mistaken for complete assurance.
- Simplified the CLI scan-session card and refined the live progress row with readable limits, consistent casing, and no meaningless `0.0 req/s` output.
- Documented why Full Scan prioritizes coverage and verified evidence over minimum completion time, with guidance for bounded scans.

### Downloads

| Platform | Architecture | Asset |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows | x64 | `akca-windows-amd64.exe` |
| Linux | x64 | `akca-linux-amd64` |
| Linux | ARM64 | `akca-linux-arm64` |
| macOS | Intel | `akca-darwin-amd64` |
| macOS | Apple Silicon | `akca-darwin-arm64` |

`SHA256SUMS.txt` contains the SHA-256 digest for every binary. Browser-backed checks require Chrome, Chromium, or Edge.

### Install with Go

```bash
go install github.com/akha-security/akca/engine/cmd/akca@v0.2.3
```

Use AKCA only on systems you own or are explicitly authorized to test.
